name: Sikalastic-1 Komponent
paste:
SIKALASTIC®-1 KOMPONENT: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sikalastic®-1 Komponent, April 2023, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/z/sikalastic_-1_komponent.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sikalastic®-1 Komponent where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description. Sikalastic®-1Komponent is a one-component, crack-bridging,fibre-reinforced mortar, based on cement modified with special alkali-resistant polymers. Sikalastic®-1Komponent is suitable for application by brush or trowel.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - ▪Flexible waterproofing and protection of concrete structures including tanks, basins, pipes etc. ▪Waterproofing of bathrooms, showers, terraces, balconies,swimming pools before the application of ceramic tiles bonded with adhesives
    - ▪Waterproofing of external wall surfaces to be back-filled in ground
    - ▪Inside waterproofing of negative water pressure of walls and floors in basements
    - ▪Flexible protection coating for reinforced concrete structures against the effects of freeze-thaw and carbon dioxide attack to improve durability
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.8.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sikalastic®-1 Komponent
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: ONE-COMPONENT CEMENTITIOUS MORTAR, FIBRE-REINFORCED FOR FLEXIBLE WATERPROOFING AND CONCRETE PROTECTION
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates.
    - ▪ AS/NZS 4020 : 2005 Products for use in contact withdrinking water
    - ▪ VOC-SCAQMD Method 304-91
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS/NZS 4020 : 2005: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Approvals / Certificates (p.1).
    - EN 1062- 7: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Crack bridging ability (p.1).
    - EN 14891: cited with a stated property or value; test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Product Information > Crack bridging ability (p.1); Product Information > Tensile adhesion strength (p.2); Product Information > Water penetration under pressure (p.2).
    - EN 1542: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Tensile adhesion strength (p.2).
    - EN 1062-3: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Capillary absorption (p.2).
    - EN 12390- 8: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Water penetration under pressure (p.2).
    - EN ISO 7783-1: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Permeability to water vapour (p.2).
    - EN 1062-6: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Permeability to carbon dioxide (p.2).
    - EN 13501-1: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Reaction to fire (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - ▪ One-component product, only water needs to be added
    - ▪ Adjustable consistency, easy to apply by brush ortrowel
    - ▪ Good sag resistance and easy to apply, even on verticalsurfaces
    - ▪ Good crack-bridging ability
    - ▪ Very good adhesion on many substrates including concrete, cement mortars, stone, masonry
    - ▪ Can be applied on damp substrates
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Cement modified with alkali resistant polymers, selected aggregates, fine fillers admixtures, additives and fibres.
    - Appearance and colour: Light grey
    - Fresh mortar density: ~1,5 kg/l
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Crack bridging ability: > 0,50 mm (Class A 3, +23 °C) 1 (EN 1062- 7); ≥ 0,75 mm (+23 °C) 2 (EN 14891 A.8.2); ≥ 0,75 mm (–5 °C) 2 (EN 14891 A.8.3)
    - Capillary absorption: ~0,02 kg/m2·h0.5 (EN 1062-3)
    - Water penetration under pressure: No penetration after 72h at 5.0 bar 1 (EN 12390- 8)2; No penetration after 7 days at 1.5 bar 3 (EN 14891 A.7)
    - Water penetration under negative pressure: no penetration after 72h at 2.5 bar (UNI 8298/8)
    - Permeability to water vapour: Class I (permeable) SD < 5 m (EN ISO 7783-1)
    - Permeability to carbon dioxide: SD ≥ 50 m (EN 1062-6)
    - Reaction to fire: Euroclass A2 (EN 13501-1)
2.7 Tensile adhesion strength. ≥ 0,8 N/mm2 (EN 1542); Value obtained with a total layer thickness of 3 mm in two layers with 22 % water
    | Test method | Requirement |
    | Initial tensile | A.6.2 | ≥ 0,5 N/mm2 |
    | adhesion strength |
    | Tensile adhesion | A.6.2 | ≥ 0,5 N/mm2 |
    | strength after water contact |
    | Tensile adhesion | A.6.2 | ≥ 0,5 N/mm2 |
    | strength after heat aging |
    | Tensile adhesion | A.6.2 | ≥ 0,5 N/mm2 |
    | strength after freeze-thaw cycles |
    | Tensile adhesion | A.6.2 | ≥ 0,5 N/mm2 |
    | strength after contact with lime water |
    | Tensile adhesion | A.6.2 | ≥ 0,5 N/mm2 |
    | strength after contact with chlorinated water |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    Test method printed: (EN 14891)
    Note printed: Values obtained with a total consumption of 3.6 kg/m2 in two layers with 30 % water
2.8 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 10kg Pails
    - Shelf life: 12 months from date of production
    - Storage conditions: Store properly in the original packaging, in cool and dry conditions. Protect from water.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality / pre-treatment.
    - Substrates must be structurally sound, clean, dry and free of all contaminants such as dirt, oil, grease, cement laitance, coatings and other surface treatments etc.
    - Clean surfaces by blast cleaning, high-pressure water-jetting (400 bar), wire-brushing, grinding etc., in order to remove all previous coatings, any traces of grease, rust, release agents, cement laitance and any other material which could reduce adhesion. All dust deposits from this preparation must also be removed i.e. by vacuum.
    - Repair concrete substrates, if necessary, with an appropriate cementitious mortar from the Sika MonoTop® range of repair materials.The substrate shall be adequately dampened before application. The surface shall not be moist to the touch and shall not be dark matte (saturated surface dry) appearance.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Consumption: This depends on the substrate roughness; as a guide: ~1,2 kg/m2/mm
    - Layer thickness: 3 mm with constant thickness, applied in minimum 2 layers. Maximum recommended thickness per layer is 2 mm when applied by trowel and 1 mm when applied by brush
    - Pot Life: ~30 min at +20 °C
4.3 Mixing ratio.
    | Application Method | Water Dosage |
    | By brush | ~6,0 litres water per 20 kg bag |
    | By rowel | ~4,4 litres water per 20 kg bag |
4.4 Waiting time to overcoating. Sikalastic®-1Komponent must be completely hardened before over-coating or water contact. Guide for waiting times at the following temperatures:
    | +20 °C | +10 °C |
    | Horizontal covering by | ~2 days | ~7 days |
    | tiles |
    | Vertical covering by | ~2 days | ~3 days |
    | tiles |
    | Water emulsion coating | ~2 days | ~3 days |
    | Immersion in water | ~2 days | ~7 days |
    | Contact with drinkable | ~15 days | ~15 days |
    | water |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    Note printed: Times will vary due to ambient and substrate humidity
4.5 Mixing.
    - Sikalastic®-1Komponent can be mixed with a low speed (~ 500r/min) hand drill mixer, adding the right quantity of water according to the respective application. Once a homogeneous mix is obtained, continue mixing for 3–4 min. The mortar must be homogeneous and lump free.
    - Do not add any additional water or other ingredients. Each bag must be entirely mixed, to avoid faulty particle size distribution of aggregates contained in the powder component.
4.6 Application - Special Requirements.
    - All connections between the substrate and pipe entries, plant and equipment, and penetrations, must be sealed and watertight. Joints in concrete, pipes or anywhere else in the structure must also be sealed and made watertight.
    - Use a coved detail at the floor/wall junctions.
    - Apply Sikalastic®-1Komponent by:
    - ▪Trowel/spatula: Exerting good and even pressure onto the substrate;
    - ▪Brush/roller: In 2 directions (diagonally opposite / cross-wise);
    - The optimum waterproofing performance is obtained by applying Sikalastic®-1Komponent by trowel in at least 2 layers, to a total thickness of at least 3 mm.
    - Application by brush must be undertaken with the maximum attention to uniformly covering the whole surface. The maximum recommended thickness for these methods of application is 1 mm per layer. In these situations, the application of min. 2–3 layers is required (subsequent layers must be applied crosswise).
    - Wait until the first layer is dry before applying subsequent layers.
    - The application shall cover the whole surface of the substrate in a uniform thickness. Sikalastic®-1Komponent cannot be smoothed using float or sponge trowel. It is possible to smooth the surface as soon as the curing of the product is complete by light abrasion techniques.
    - Joints
    - At joints or other critical movement areas (for example junctions with vertical surfaces), the waterproofing may be reinforced by Sika® Seal Tape S. It must be applied directly on the fresh first layer and then covered by the second layer of Sikalastic®-1Komponent.Tilling Ceramic and vitreous tiles may be installed on Sikalastic ®-1Komponent using a polymer modified cement based tile adhesive in the Sika® CTA® range. All joints and gaps must be sealed.
4.7 Cleaning of equipment. Tools should be thoroughly cleaned with water before the material has set. Hardened mortar can only be removed mechanically.
4.8 Limitations and important considerations.
    - ▪ Sikalastic®-1Komponent shall not be smoothed using a float or trowel.
    - ▪ Protect from rain for at least 24–48 h after application.
    - ▪ Avoid direct contact with chlorinated water i.e. in swimming pools, by using suitable protection.
    - ▪ Avoid application in direct sun light, when rain is imminent or in strong winds.
    - ▪ Setting time can be influenced by high relative humidity, particularly in closed rooms or basements.
    - ▪ The use of adequate ventilation is recommended.
    - ▪ Before contact with drinking water, ensure the Sikalastic®-1Komponent is completely hardened respecting the suggested waiting times and wash carefully to remove dust, loose material or stagnant water, according to local regulations.
    - ▪ Sikalastic®-1Komponent is permeable to water vapour and does not form a vapour barrier for resin based systems not permeable to gas.
    - ▪ If a solvent based paint is to be applied on Sikalastic®-1Komponent, carry out preliminary testing in order to ensure the solvents do not attack and damage the waterproofing layer.
    - ▪ When used in contact with drinking water, ensure Sikalastic®-1Komponent and all associated Sika® products comply with the local regulations for drinking water contact.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. 5 °C min. / 35 °C max.
5.3 Substrate temperature. 5 °C min. / 35 °C max.
5.4 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.8):
    - ▪ Protect from rain for at least 24–48 h after application.
    - ▪ Avoid application in direct sun light, when rain is imminent or in strong winds.
    - ▪ Setting time can be influenced by high relative humidity, particularly in closed rooms or basements.
5.5 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Tensile adhesion strength: Test method | Requirement; Initial tensile | A.6.2 | ≥ 0,5 N/mm2; adhesion strength; Tensile adhesion | A.6.2 | ≥ 0,5 N/mm2; strength after water contact; Tensile adhesion | A.6.2 | ≥ 0,5 N/mm2; strength after heat aging; Tensile adhesion | A.6.2 | ≥ 0,5 N/mm2; strength after freeze-thaw cycles; Tensile adhesion | A.6.2 | ≥ 0,5 N/mm2; strength after contact with lime water; Tensile adhesion | A.6.2 | ≥ 0,5 N/mm2; strength after contact with chlorinated water; ≥ 0,8 N/mm2 (EN 1542); Value obtained with a total layer thickness of 3 mm in two layers with 22 % water (EN 14891)
5.6 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.7 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sikalastic®-1 Komponent, April 2023, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/z/sikalastic_-1_komponent.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sikalastic 1 Komponent, version 10/08/2021, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/e/Sikalastic%201%20Komponent%20GHS7.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sikalastic®-1 Komponent, version 24/11/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/f/sds-sikalastic-1komponent.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
